works.description: 三角錐作為工具，在城市的角落作為佔地道具，在街邊成為有趣的畫面。將外觀比例重新設計，轉化為產品物件，也設想在新舊市容的轉化中，有沒有更多的應用。
works.longDescription:
從都市觀察出發，以市區角落的物件作為材料。保存對於台北舊街景的記憶，街頭上觀察到的獨有元素做為主題。

以城市中三角錐的使用方法、擺放形式為切入點，重新調整三角錐的整體比例，轉化成產品語彙，同時思考在都市更新的過程中，有什麼東西是能夠被延續，持續利用的，在新的環境中賦予舊環境中的物件新的可能性。
works.english:
By redesigning the proportions of the traffic cone, it becomes more than just a
space-marking tool—it transforms into an intriguing urban element. This design also explores its potential applications in the evolving cityscape.
works.english_detail:
Drawing from urban observations, this design reimagines traffic cones as a product language while preserving Taipei’s old street memories. By refining their
proportions and placement, it explores how familiar urban elements can be repurposed, extending their relevance and function within evolving cityscapes.

works.description: 工地，暫時的場所，空間內、外部轉換時的空間。帆布作為工地常見的材料之一，提供遮擋、保護的作用，縮小尺度，將工地鷹架和帆布的元素融入家具之中。
works.longDescription:
從都市觀察出發，以市區角落的物件作為材料。保存對於台北舊街景的記憶，台北街頭上觀察到的獨有元素做為主題。

在都市更新的過程中，工地作為空間內、外部轉換時一種暫時存在的空間，時常出現在我們的視野中，通常是大規模的呈現，嘗試縮小其規模，以工地代表性的帆布和鷹架作為主要的符號，轉化到產品物件中。
works.english: A construction site is a transitional space, where canvas is commonly used for coverage and protection. This design miniaturizes scaffolding and canvas elements, incorporating them into furniture to explore new structural possibilities while reflecting the aesthetics of temporary architecture.
works.english_detail: Inspired by urban observation, this design uses materials from city corners to preserve the memory of old Taipei streets. It scales down the large-scale elements of construction sites, using scaffolding and canvas as symbols, transforming them into functional product objects.
